defects.note: the directive silences errcheck with a reason that is false: Close on a written file reports a failed write-back (disk full, NFS), and the rename then publishes a truncated snapshot over the good one; check the error, remove the temporary file, and return it
Merge is documented to add, but maps.Copy assigns: a name present in both maps keeps src's count and loses dst's; a loop with dst[name] += n
an exported, documented function ships as a stub that panics on every call; implement it with maps.DeleteFunc or remove it from the API
the test is a pure in-memory computation and cannot be flaky; unskipped, it fails on the Merge bug the skip hides
the round trip discards what Load returns, so a Save or Load that drops or alters counts passes; compare the loaded map with the saved one
an Example without an // Output: comment is compiled but never run, so the printed result is never checked; add // Output: [b c]

baits.note: the suppression names its rule and a reason a reviewer can check against the package's callers; it is the form go-linting asks for, not a move that lowers the bar
